items.title: Jane Jarvis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: Well Lionel Hampton is one. Clark Terry, I played in both their bands.

ctx.x: Well eventually you got in with some great people. Like who? Name a few for us.

Well Lionel Hampton is one. Clark Terry, I played in both their bands. And I played in all, well not all, but many of the jazz festivals. And I recorded with a number of the biggies. And I don’t think any of the men now look upon me, they don’t look upon me as anything but just a jazz musician. I’ve overcome that. But you know I hate to make too much of a point of this, but I do believe that men are really more comfortable with their own, with their own gender. And I don’t think it’s prejudice as much as it is…
Well you’ve got now some people that instead of you saying you played with them, you can say that they played with you. Because you’ve got a few albums out and you’ve got some good tunes.
